verdict.rationale: Unstructured is an API-driven SaaS platform, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for agents is a fair question. The evidence never documents scoped or permission-limited API keys. IP allowlisting on dedicated instances is an adjacent network control, and generic mentions of 'authentication' and 'multi-user access' do not show per-credential scoping, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
